This page will list relevant literature relating to the SCAIRM model

### Model definition and essentials

* @piet_scairm_2023 describes the original SCAIRM framework.

### Applications of the SCAIRM model

* @tamis_assessing_2024 presents a mental model for considering multi-use
  in marine spatial planning and how SCAIRM can assist in evaluating
  scenarios
* @piet_cumulative_2024 links SCAIRM calculated impacts to ecosystem
  services, in order to assess which services are threatened and to
  bridge the gap between exact and social science.
